title: SKI
description_en: Voice-first coding harness . Talk to your coding agents and hear them talk back. SKI runs Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, OpenCode, Antigravity and pi side by side on your Mac, and tells you the moment one needs you.

title: telemetry.dev
description_en: LLM observability for AI agents. telemetry.dev shows each run of your AI agent as one trace. Each model call and tool call is a span with its duration, tokens, cost, and error. Prompts and evals use the same traces: change a prompt without a deploy, then run it on a dataset and compare the scores with production. Alerts tell you about errors, cost spikes, and agent loops. Connect with our TypeScript or Python SDK, or with the OpenTelemetry exporter that you already use.

title: ClawsGO Science
description_en: The AI research agent with its own cloud lab. Research, fully automated. ClawsGO Science takes a question to discovery and writes it up as a cited paper. Its cloud lab has 500+ tools and 90+ datasets. Its long-horizon harness runs clusters of Claude and GPT agents for days. The next paradigm for science.

title: Backenly
description_en: The autonomous backend for AI coding agents. Backenly is an autonomous backend platform built for coding agents. Your agent builds the backend over MCP, from Postgres to sign-in, storage, functions and realtime. Then it maintains itself: every minute a self-healing loop repairs missing indexes, RLS gaps and dead realtime triggers, verifying each fix live. As your app grows, it restructures its own schema once you approve. Risky changes wait for you, and every change is versioned with rollback.

title: WinnerAdSpy
description_en: Turn competitor ad insights into winning app campaigns. Winneradspy is an ad creative intelligence platform built specifically for mobile app and game marketers. Explore 20M+ ad creatives across 200K+ apps, uncover winning hooks, visuals, messaging and CTAs, and track competitor campaigns with real-time alerts. Unlike generic ad spy tools, it scores creatives as Winner, Loser or Learning, helping UA managers, growth teams and agencies understand what works and build better campaigns. Query ad insights through ChatGPT, Claude or Gemini via MCP.

title: Riverside Agents
description_en: A team of AI agents for video: produce, edit, clip, post. Riverside Agents is a team of AI agents built only for video. A Producer preps your session, an Editor turns raw recordings into a finished episode, a Clipper cuts the best moments into social clips, and a Marketer writes captions and schedules posts. You choose how much to automate, and nothing is published until you approve it. Included in every Riverside plan, with a 14-day free trial.

title: Precise Edit by Ideogram
description_en: Precise editing with context window. The upgraded Precise Edit supports a context window, so it edits images at any resolution up to 8K at their original pixels and renders small text, logos, and fine detail more sharply.

title: Embage
description_en: Build agent for your customers, run workflows, analyzed. . Build multichannel AI chat and voice agents for your website, Telegram, and beyond. Create specialized sub-agents to orchestrate workflows across your knowledge bases, datastores, and hundreds of third-party tools in real time. Automatically evaluate every interaction, score lead quality, and extract structured data straight from conversation transcripts.

title: agentmash
description_en: open-source multiplayer AI for teams' coding agents. Agentmash is an open-source multiplayer AI for teams' coding agents, a shared context layer that tells every agent which files a teammate's agent is changing, so the agents talk to each other and work on their own without overwriting anyone's code. You can switch between tasks running on different models, @mention a teammate, your own agent or a teammate's agent like in Slack, and keep skills, chats and automations in sync. Connect Claude Code, Codex, Antigravity or your own open-source models

title: GitHub Copilot Fusion
description_en: GitHub's AI coding agent that picks and combines models. GitHub Copilot Fusion takes the guesswork out of choosing AI models for coding. Instead of picking one model, Fusion automatically routes each task to suitable models and combines them when needed. One model can write code while another reviews or improves it. Choose Standard, High, or Max effort to balance speed, quality, and cost. Available across GitHub Copilot plans in VS Code, Copilot CLI, the Copilot app, and JetBrains IDEs.

title: Click
description_en: Managed agents API that works with any model. Managed Agents API you can use with any model. Send a task with an API call, and Click runs the agent and streams back results. Click gives you the entire agent stack over an API, with no infrastructure to manage. Sessions are created with everything your agent needs - a sandbox, browser, and web search. Agents run on a harness with the latest innovations, like deferred tool discovery to support 1000s of tools, and Code Mode to use tools with scripts.

title: Modelpeers
description_en: Follow AI models and agents like you follow people. Modelpeers is like LinkedIn for AI models and agents. Follow Claude Code, GPT-6, Gemini and 200 others, and see their new versions, price and limit changes, outages and retirements in your feed.

title: BaseTab AI
description_en: Turn your new tab into an AI-powered workspace. BaseTab turns your browser's empty new tab into a dashboard you arrange yourself. Drag in 30+ widgets: notes, to-dos, Kanban, Pomodoro, bookmarks, weather, Google Calendar, Gmail, and chat with Claude, ChatGPT or Gemini. Missing a widget? Describe it in plain words and AI builds it for you. Keep separate workspaces for work and life, share one with your team, and pick a background that feels like home. Free forever, works without an account, and asks for site access only when a widget needs it.

title: Coding Wrapped
description_en: See how you really vibe code with Claude Code & Codex. Your agent remembers every session. You don't. Coding Wrapped turns your local Claude Code & Codex history into a pixel-art Wrapped: your rhythm, the words you repeat ("continue", anyone?), what the agent quietly took over, and one small tip for each habit. Open source, one command, 100% local.

title: Godwit
description_en: An open-source, AI-native email client. Godwit is an open-source desktop email client for any IMAP/SMTP account, with an AI assistant, Wit, that reads, summarizes, translates and drafts mail with the model you choose.

title: Raah.dev
description_en: Track your revenue, analytics, and website performance. Connect payments and conversions with page speed, API latency, errors, and ISP performance in one dashboard. Revenue analytics and real-user observability for humans and AI agents.

title: AC Bridge
description_en: Your smart lights show when Claude Code or Codex needs you.. AC Bridge turns the smart lights and plugs you already own into ambient status for Claude Code and Codex. See at a glance whether your agent is working, blocked or done, and let Claude Code or Codex drive the devices you have connected, as a step in a task. Works with Hue, Govee, WLED, LIFX, Nanoleaf and more, plus Home Assistant.

title: Agnos
description_en: Clean documents for AI, and see what was removed. Agnos cleans PDFs, Word, Excel, PowerPoint and web pages before they go into an AI chatbot, a RAG knowledge base or training data. It removes repeated headers and footers, page numbers, cookie banners, boilerplate and duplicates, and keeps tables, code and numbers. It names the rule behind every removal; keep a piece or switch its rule off. Exports JSONL chunks, cleaned text or training data. Runs on your Windows PC; nothing is uploaded. From the Microsoft Store: 14 days free, then $99 once.

title: Pluto Door
description_en: SSH client with an AI agent and a desktop for every server. This launch adds Ori, an AI agent that reads your servers, finds what's wrong and explains it in plain English. When something needs to change, you see every command first and nothing runs until you approve; every edited file can be undone. Pluto XOS turns each server into a desktop with 15 apps, Hangar installs software in one click, and scheduled checks notify you before small problems grow. Works with AWS, Google Cloud and Azure. Your servers and keys stay on your Mac. Free for 14 days.

title: Termy
description_en: Your coding agent, in the notch. Claude Code and Codex in a terminal that drops down from your MacBook's notch. Live status, approvals from the notch, an office of your agents, a browser for your local server, on-device dictation and checkpoints.

title: Usage for Claude + ChatGPT 4.0
description_en: Claude + ChatGPT limits on your Mac, iPhone, iPad and Watch. Version 4 is a big one. Usage for Claude now tracks ChatGPT accounts too, with your Codex session and weekly limits next to Claude's. See every account at once in three styles (Minimal, Detailed, Chart), put several in the Mac menu bar, and keep them on iPhone, iPad, Apple Watch and widgets. Alerts tell you before you run out, and the history shows where your week went. You sign in on the official Claude and ChatGPT pages, and your data stays in your own iCloud. Free, with Pro extras.

title: ernd
description_en: The credit card for the AI stack. ernd is a credit card for companies that pay for AI. Card spend at AI vendors earns 4% back, and we're negotiating big partnerships with AI providers for better pricing, faster inference and dedicated GPUs.

title: Fluent 2
description_en: AI teammates that run locally on your Mac. Introducing AI teammates – saving hours on your routine. They use your apps like you do and keep working while you sleep. Run them on a local model: fully private, no usage limits, and $0 a month. Or pick any cloud model you like.

title: Alertedly
description_en: Competitor intelligence for your team and AI agents. Alertedly watches your competitors across 16 public channels: pricing pages, product launches, hiring, ads, Reddit, reviews, trademarks and more. Every change comes with its source. Get alerts in Slack, a clean brief in your inbox, or connect your AI agents over MCP and ask Claude, ChatGPT or Cursor "what did my competitors ship this month?" No more tracking competitors manually.

title: Tracked
description_en: Time tracking, the Mac way.. Native time tracking for freelancers who bill by the hour. Start a timer from the menu bar or the MacBook notch, and fix forgotten time by dragging blocks onto your day. Projects with hourly rates and budgets become PDF timesheets clients accept. A built-in MCP server lets Claude start timers and log your hours. Import your full history from Tyme, Toggl, Clockify, Harvest & more. No account, your data stays on your devices. One purchase covers Mac, iPhone, iPad & Apple Watch, widgets included.

title: ScaleReach
description_en: Turn one long video into 15 ready-to-post shorts. ScaleReach turns long videos into captioned vertical clips for TikTok, Reels and Shorts. Paste a YouTube, Twitch or Drive link and AI finds the best moments, ranks them with a viral score, reframes to 9:16 with face tracking and adds word-level captions in 50+ languages. Schedule posts to TikTok, YouTube, Instagram and more from one dashboard. Pay per source minute, not per clip, from about $0.03/min. Start free, no card. PH special: use EXTRA200 at Pro checkout for 200 extra minutes.

title: PixelShine
description_en:
Your Own AI Creative Studio + More 200 AI one tap apps.... Create more, edit less. Bring your visual ideas to life with PixelShine AI — 200+ AI photo apps and free creative tools in one place.

title: Arsaze
description_en: Cursor for video editing. Make one cut, Tab the rest. Arsaze is Cursor for video editing. Make one cut and press Tab: it previews your next edit on the timeline and learns how you cut. Edit the transcript like a doc, or let Claude, ChatGPT or Gemini edit the real timeline while you watch, with every change versioned. Clients review on the exact frame, and your AI fixes their notes. Free plan: no-watermark exports, on-device transcription and unlimited review links. Windows, Mac, Linux, web and mobile.

title: Clipmetry
description_en: Find the competitor reels that beat their own baseline. Clipmetry tracks your competitors' Instagram Reels and scores every post against that account's own baseline to find real outliers. AI explains why each one worked, then turns them into briefs, scripts and a 30-day calendar. No Instagram login needed.

title: Selah
description_en: Memorize Bible verses one at a time, free and ad-free. Selah helps you memorize Scripture and keep it. Pick a popular verse, a whole chapter, a themed pack, or any passage. Short exercises take you from reading to full recall: fill in the blanks, rebuild the verse, first-letter prompts, then say it from memory. Once you master a passage, spaced repetition brings it back at the right time so it sticks. Daily reminders at your pace. Free, with no ads, no subscriptions and no in-app purchases.

title: Treasures
description_en: Keep the things you own, love, and discover together.. Everything you love, in one little universe. There’s room for every find, with unlimited personal items and collections, now free. Share yours in Club, explore other collectors’ favorite pieces, and find inspiration for what comes next. Bring new finds into your collection with a photo or with our extensions. AI Autofill adds the details and assigns topics, while High mode searches online for images. New Image Styles give your finds a studio-style finish. Available on iOS, Android and web.

title: landmine
description_en: Lockfile in. Known bugs out. Before your agent edits.. Your agent never checks GitHub for bugs in your exact versions. landmine does: it reads your lockfile, finds open issues filed against those versions, and gives the agent the bug and the workaround via AGENTS.md, a pre-edit hook or MCP. Free and open source.

title: ScreenShipper
description_en: App Store & Google Play screenshots, ready in minutes. Turn your app screens into store-ready screenshots. Pick from 100+ templates, write your copy, and export every iPhone, iPad and Android size in one ZIP. 50 languages with AI translation. Free to start, no design skills needed.

title: static.md
description_en: Markdown notes your AI agents can read and write. Write markdown notes and whiteboards with your team, and let Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor or VS Code search, read and write them over MCP, and keep their memory there. You approve what each agent can do. Encrypted notes stay end-to-end. Free to start.

title: Proferex
description_en: Track and Optimize Ad Campaigns with AI Agents. We built the ad tracker we wanted to use. Ask the agent which campaigns lost money this week, and it reads your stats, tells you why and lines up the fix. Already pay for Claude or ChatGPT? Connect it over MCP and ask there. Nothing changes until you say yes.

title: Zush
description_en: AI File Renamer & Organizer for Mac & Windows. Zush used to just rename files. Now it sorts them into folders too: AI picks the folders, or you write a rule like "invoices by company, receipts by year and month". Also new: Custom AI Blocks that put any detail (invoice number, client, total) into a filename, a Movies and TV template for Plex, music grouped by artist and album, sequence numbers, and video names from speech and subtitles. Works on Mac and Windows with cloud AI, your own API key, or local models.

title: ArtifactSend
description_en: Free DocSend alternative that Claude and ChatGPT can drive. Share a PDF, pitch deck, Word, PowerPoint or Excel file, or a Claude artifact as a private link. See who opened it, how far they read and time on each page. Email gates, a link per person, expiry, watermarks, NDAs and data rooms are free, with unlimited team members. Ask Claude or ChatGPT who read your deck through our MCP server. We only charge when AI works for you, a few cents at a time.

title: RuleInside
description_en: Managed AI Voice Agents for WordPress Stores. Stop answering every customer inquiry yourself. RuleInside gives your WordPress or WooCommerce store a team of AI agents that we build and run. Your shoppers get an answer at any hour. Each agent owns one job: answering questions, closing the sale, recovering carts, checking in after delivery or bringing back past buyers. They work by phone, website chat and WhatsApp, in the customer's language, using your live prices, stock and orders. A person still decides anything that moves money.

title: thedotmack/claude-mem
description_en: Persistent Context Across Sessions for Every Agent – Captures everything your agent does during sessions, compresses it with AI, and injects relevant context back into future sessions. Works with Claude Code, OpenClaw, Codex, Gemini, Hermes, Copilot, OpenCode + More
